trigger_condition: Chunk has a thought plus a field outside _PAYLOAD_KEYS (context, workflow_state, success, error_details, money_spent, routing, workflow_execution_id) and none of the enumerated keys is truthy
guard_snippet: derive payload presence from `any(v is not None for k, v in data.items() if k not in ("thought","debug"))` instead of a fixed key list
potential_consequence: Whole chunk is dropped, silently losing workflow_state events, cost/routing metadata or error_details alongside the thought

trigger_condition: Final chunk carries error_details (full detail of execution_error, per its own docstring) while hide_tool_outputs is on
guard_snippet: if data.get("last") and "error_details" in data: data["error_details"] = None
potential_consequence: Full tool/execution error detail leaks to a hidden-output assistant even though tool_errors was nulled

trigger_condition: Underlying stream yields an empty string chunk (e.g. a keep-alive/heartbeat frame)
guard_snippet: if text == "": return chunk  # pass empty keep-alive frames through untouched
potential_consequence: Keep-alive frames are swallowed by strip_chunk, changing stream timing/behavior only when hide_tool_outputs is on

trigger_condition: strip_response given a pydantic response whose model_fields has neither 'thoughts' nor 'tool_errors' (any future/alternate response schema)
guard_snippet: if not update: logger.error(f"No strippable fields on {type(response).__name__}")
potential_consequence: Hidden-output response is returned completely unstripped with no log, silently defeating the policy for that response type

trigger_condition: Tool-call resume after an initial ask that used a version-pinned execution_assistant whose hide_tool_outputs differed from the current master assistant
guard_snippet: look up the pinned version via the checkpoint/conversation and OR its hide_tool_outputs into the resume decision, as ask_assistant_by_id/_by_slug do via _effective_hide_tool_outputs
potential_consequence: Resume only checks the master assistant, so a version pin that hid tool outputs can be bypassed by resuming the pending tool call

trigger_condition: Conversation hands off to a new assistant mid-live-stream that is not yet in conversation.assistant_ids/initial_assistant_id at request time
guard_snippet: re-evaluate is_any_hidden per emitted chunk (e.g. from an assistant_id carried on the chunk) instead of once from the pre-fetched id list
potential_consequence: Tool output from a hidden assistant introduced by a later handoff streams unstripped because the hide decision was computed once up front

trigger_condition: conversation.is_workflow_conversation is True and a workflow step's assistant_id maps to a hidden assistant
guard_snippet: populate assistant_data / verify strip_history coverage for workflow conversations the same way as regular ones, rather than relying on it being a no-op
potential_consequence: If a workflow conversation ever carries per-message assistant_ids for a hidden sub-assistant, thoughts for it are not confirmed stripped
